rules: PRNG: mulberry32(seed); every choice below draws from it in program order.
40 scenarios; each has 2-10 declarations and 12 requests.

Declaration: 0-3 segments, each static (a|b|c|x, p=0.5), plain param (p=0.25) or constrained param (p=0.25) using one of \d+ | [a-c]+ | [0-9a-f]{2}; then a final catch-all with p=0.2. Param names are p<index>.
Declaration method from GET x3, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, HEAD, OPTIONS. A GET is buffer with p=0.7, else sse | ndjson | negotiate; every other method is buffer.

Request path: p=0.6 instantiate a random declaration (static -> its literal, param -> value pool, catch-all -> 0-2 pool values), else 0-4 random pool segments. Value pool: a b c x 7 42 ff 0a a%20b caf%C3%A9 %34%32.
Request decoration: trailing slash p=0.15, a dot segment (/./ or /q/../) inserted p=0.1, a repeated slash p=0.05.
Request method from GET x2, HEAD, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, OPTIONS.
Unsupported patterns are never produced: every generated pattern must pass compilePattern.
